It was founded by Dilip Suryavanshi in 1987 and was incorporated in the [[Ministry of Corporate Affairs]] on 12 June 2006.{{cite web |url=https://www.zaubacorp.com/company/DILIP-BUILDCON-LIMITED/L45201MP2006PLC018689 |title=Company profile of Dilip Buildcon Limited |work=ZaubaCorp |access-date=25 September 2021 }} The company is listed on both the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] (BSE){{cite web |title=Stock Share Price {{!}} Get Quote {{!}} BSE |url=https://www.bseindia.com/stock-share-price/dilip-buildcon/dilip-buildcon/540047/ |website=Bseindia.com}} and the [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]] (NSE) since August 2016.{{cite web |title=Dilip Buildcon Limited |url=https://www1.nseindia.com/live_market/dynaContent/live_watch/get_quote/GetQuote.jsp?symbol=DBL |publisher=NSE India}}{{cite web |title=Check out 's stock price (DBL-IN) in real time |url=https://www.cnbc.com/quotes/DBL-IN |website=CNBC |date=29 January 2012 |language=en}}{{cite web |title=Dilip Buildcon has bright years ahead: Why it is stock pick of the week |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/wealth/invest/dilip-buildcon-has-bright-years-ahead-why-it-is-stock-pick-of-the-week/articleshow/83661216.cms |website=The Economic Times}}{{cite news |last1=Raj |first1=Shubham |title=Market Movers: What led to rally in Dilip Buildcon; PSU banks, RIL give sell signals |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/market-movers-what-led-to-rally-in-dilip-buildcon-psu-banks-ril-give-sell-signals/articleshow/81331350.cms |website=The Economic Times|date=4 March 2021 }} == History == Dilip Buildcon Limited (DBL) was founded in 1987 in Bhopal by Dilip Suryavanshi as a proprietorship concern called Dilip Builders. The company was incorporated as Dilip Buildcon Private Limited on 12 June 2006 as a [[private limited company]] under the Companies Act 1956 with the Registrar of Companies Gwalior. Subsequently, the company took over the business of Dilip Builders, a [[sole proprietorship]] concern, in 2007. The company registered as a [[public limited company]] in August 2010. In the initial years of its operation, the company focused on commercial and residential building projects in Madhya Pradesh.{{cite web |title=Dilip Buildcon Share Price, Dilip Buildcon Stock Price, Dilip Buildcon Ltd. Stock Price, Share Price, Live BSE/NSE, Dilip Buildcon Ltd. Bids Offers. The first move was into water sanitation and sewage.{{cite news |title=CIL arm awards Rs 1,470 crore project to Dilip Buildcon JV |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/indl-goods/svs/metals-mining/cil-arm-awards-rs-1470-crore-project-to-dilip-buildcon-jv/articleshow/55493499.cms |website=The Economic Times|date=18 November 2016 }}{{cite web |last1=Shah |first1=Reeta |title=Dilip Buildcon lowest bidder for Indore Metro project |url=https://www.metrorailnews.in/dilip-buildcon-lowest-bidder-for-indore-metro-project/ |website=Metro Rail News |date=21 September 2018}} The company also did structural designing and construction in the field of the oil and gas industry. At the end of the 1990s, when the new central government put forward a vision of connecting the country with roads, DBL ventured into road construction starting with a small road project.{{cite web extract: Dilip Buildcon Limited (DBL) is an Indian construction and infrastructure development company based in Bhopal. It was founded by Dilip Suryavanshi in 1987 and was incorporated in the Ministry of Corporate Affairs on 12 June 2006. The company is listed on both the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) and the National Stock Exchange (NSE) since August 2016.
